lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: High-intensity white circular pixel clusters arranged in approximately vertical columns and horizontal rows posterior to the gill slits.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Subtle vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity that intersect with the primary circular blobs to create a grid-like structural appearance.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A prominent horizontal linear feature on the upper third of the flank exhibiting a sharp vertical intensity gradient with highlights on the upper margin and shadowing on the lower margin.

other_distinctive_markers: The pectoral fin displays a high-density population of smaller high-luminance spots that lack the structured grid arrangement seen on the lateral flank.
